headline: Shanghai Friday QF: Jodar rallies past Ruud; Medvedev tops Paul
whyCareReason: Rafael Jodar becomes the youngest semifinalist in Shanghai history after rallying from a set down against Ruud. Daniil Medvedev wins a three-set battle against Paul.
teaser: FINAL: Jodar d. Ruud 4-6, 6-4, 6-3. Medvedev d. Paul 6-3, 1-6, 6-3. Both advance to Saturday's semifinals on Stadium Court.
story: The ATP results page for Friday 16 October at the Rolex Shanghai Masters confirmed both remaining semifinal spots. 20-year-old Spaniard Rafael Jodar mounted his fourth consecutive comeback win of the tournament, recovering from a set down to defeat Casper Ruud 4-6, 6-4, 6-3 in two hours and 20 minutes on Stadium Court. Jodar broke Ruud five times across sets two and three. In the following quarterfinal, fifth-seeded Daniil Medvedev overcame 15th-seeded Tommy Paul 6-3, 1-6, 6-3 in two hours and eight minutes, hitting 16 aces and 31 winners to reach his 70th tour-level semifinal. Jodar and Medvedev meet in Saturday's second semifinal.
stakes: Jodar and Medvedev advanced to face each other in Saturday's semifinals, joining Alexander Zverev and Alejandro Davidovich Fokina.
rivalryAngle: Jodar's breakout Masters run continues as he reaches the semifinals in his debut full ATP Tour season.
funFacts: Final 1: Rafael Jodar d. Casper Ruud 4-6, 6-4, 6-3 (2h 20m).
Final 2: Daniil Medvedev d. Tommy Paul 6-3, 1-6, 6-3 (2h 08m, 16 aces).
Jodar becomes the youngest semifinalist in Rolex Shanghai Masters tournament history.
